summary: Israel eliminated two senior Hamas commanders in Gaza, including the Rafah Brigade commander involved in holding hostages since 2014. Yemen's Houthis claimed a strike on fuel tanks at Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, while the U.S. issued security alerts across seven Middle Eastern capitals. Iran conveyed conditions for ending its conflict with the U.S. via Qatar, awaiting Trump's response.
key_points: IDF and Shin Bet killed Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Nael Abu Obeid, who held Lt. Hadar Goldin's body in 2014 and hostages including Sgt. Nimrod Cohen in Gaza tunnels. (Source: @idf_telegram/25157)
Israel struck and killed Hamas commander Muhammad Suleiman Bayouk in Khan Younis, who infiltrated Israel on Oct. 7 and planted IEDs during the war. (Source: @New_security8200/203857)
Two Israeli soldiers were lightly wounded by a Hezbollah IED in southern Lebanon; IDF retaliated against Hezbollah observation posts and infrastructure. (Source: @amitsegal/65005)
Houthis claimed targeting fuel tanks at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh; French media reported an Aramco fuel tank fire near the airport. (Source: @presstv/207462, @naya_foriraq/90993)
U.S. embassies in Jerusalem, Amman, Baghdad, Doha, Muscat, Manama, and Beirut issued security alerts warning of flight cancellations and airspace closures. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7283)
Iran and Oman agreed on a safe shipping lane in the Strait of Hormuz; Iran sent conditions to halt war with the U.S. via Qatar, per Mohsen Rezaei. (Source: @kianmeli1/92282, @mamlekate/104555)
Houthi official Mohamed al-Bukhaiti warned Turkey and Pakistan against intervening for Saudi Arabia, threatening 'iron fist' strikes. (Source: @kianmeli1/92279)
UAE officially denied that Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed spoke with Netanyahu or conveyed warnings, stating security matters are discussed at relevant levels. (Source: @amitsegal/65013)

sections.executive_summary: Israel eliminated two senior Hamas commanders in Gaza, including the Rafah Brigade commander involved in holding hostages since 2014. Yemen's Houthis claimed a strike on fuel tanks at Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, while the U.S. issued security alerts across seven Middle Eastern capitals. Iran conveyed conditions for ending its conflict with the U.S. via Qatar, awaiting Trump's response.

points: Iran and Oman reached an understanding to establish a secure shipping lane in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson. (Source: @kianmeli1/92282)

Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, stated Iran has transmitted its conditions for halting war with the U.S. and entering negotiations via Qatar, and is awaiting President Trump's response. (Source: @mamlekate/104555)
UAV activity was detected over Urmia in West Azerbaijan Province, per monitoring by FromIran with a 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/10214)

Thousands of Iranians chanted 'Down with the USA' at Tehran's Enghelab Square on the 203rd consecutive night of nationwide rallies supporting the Islamic Republic and armed forces. (Source: @presstv/207471)

IDF and Shin Bet confirmed the killing of Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Nael Abu Obeid in an airstrike this week; he was involved in holding Lt. Hadar Goldin's body since 2014 and hostages including Sgt. Nimrod Cohen in a major tunnel system under Rafah. (Source: @idf_telegram/25157)

IDF struck and eliminated Hamas commander Muhammad Suleiman Bayouk in Khan Younis two days ago; he infiltrated Israel on Oct. 7, planted IEDs throughout Gaza, and violated the ceasefire while rebuilding Hamas capabilities. (Source: @New_security8200/203857)

Two IDF soldiers were lightly wounded when an engineering vehicle hit a Hezbollah IED in the security zone in southern Lebanon; IDF responded by striking Hezbollah observation posts and terrorist infrastructure across multiple areas. (Source: @amitsegal/65005)
Netanyahu publicly mocked the 'Axis of Resistance' at a rally, leading chants confirming the killings of Nasrallah, Sinwar, Haniyeh, and implying Khamenei's demise. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81090)

UAE officially denied reports that Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed spoke with Netanyahu or delivered warnings, stating security matters are handled at relevant levels, not leader-to-leader. (Source: @amitsegal/65013)
IDF and Shin Bet killed two Hamas operatives in a vehicle strike in the Gaza Strip, per uncensored field reports. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94377)

Israeli forces arrested two suspects near Burqa village in the Shomron Brigade area after they ignited a fire; the suspects confessed and were transferred for investigation. (Source: @New_security8200/203859)

Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Nael Abu Obeid, killed this week, held Israeli hostages in underground infrastructure in Rafah during the current war and participated in holding Lt. Hadar Goldin's body in 2014. (Source: @idf_telegram/25157)

Hamas commander Muhammad Suleiman Bayouk, killed in Khan Younis, had infiltrated Israel on Oct. 7 and spent recent months planting IEDs to target Israeli forces while violating the ceasefire. (Source: @New_security8200/203857)

An IDF engineering vehicle struck a Hezbollah IED in the security zone in southern Lebanon, lightly wounding two soldiers; IDF retaliated by striking Hezbollah observation posts and terrorist infrastructure in multiple locations. (Source: @amitsegal/65005)
An airstrike hit Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon, per live mapping of military operations. (Source: @redlinkleb/43800)

IDF continues to operate in the security zone in southern Lebanon in accordance with the agreement, and will continue to act forcefully against Hezbollah attempts to harm Israeli forces. (Source: @idf_telegram/25156)
The U.S. Embassy in Baghdad warned American citizens of potential flight cancellations and urged caution and vigilance amid regional tensions. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393288)
Iran and Oman agreed to create a secure shipping lane in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iran's Foreign Ministry. (Source: @kianmeli1/92282)

Houthis claimed responsibility for targeting fuel tanks at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh; French media reported an Aramco fuel tank fire near the airport, and flights were temporarily halted. (Source: @presstv/207462, @naya_foriraq/90993, @asafroz/53571)

U.S. embassies in Muscat, Doha, Manama, and Abu Dhabi issued STEP security alerts urging Americans to prepare for flight cancellations, airspace closures, and travel disruptions. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7283, @naya_foriraq/91018)
UAE officially denied that its ruler spoke with Netanyahu or conveyed warnings, emphasizing security discussions occur at appropriate levels. (Source: @amitsegal/65013)

Houthi official Mohamed al-Bukhaiti warned Turkey and Pakistan against intervening on Saudi Arabia's behalf, threatening 'iron fist' strikes similar to those against Saudi Arabia. (Source: @kianmeli1/92279)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous elimination of two senior Hamas commanders in Gaza demonstrates Israel's continued intelligence-driven targeting of hostage-holding leadership. Houthi claims of striking Riyadh's airport, corroborated by reports of flight halts, signal a dangerous escalation in Yemen-Saudi hostilities that could disrupt global energy flows. The broad U.S. embassy alerts across seven capitals indicate Washington anticipates imminent regional escalation, possibly linked to Iran-U.S. diplomatic brinkmanship. Hezbollah's use of IEDs in southern Lebanon despite the ceasefire suggests probing of Israeli resolve. Netanyahu's public rhetoric targeting Iran's supreme leader personally raises the risk of miscalculation.
sections.regional_response: Oman's agreement with Iran on a secure Hormuz shipping lane reflects Gulf efforts to insulate critical maritime trade from conflict spillover. The UAE's formal denial of leader-level contact with Netanyahu underscores Gulf reluctance to be drawn into Israeli-Iranian confrontation. Qatar's role as intermediary for Iran's conditions to the U.S. highlights Doha's continued mediation relevance. Saudi Arabia faces direct Houthi threats to its capital's infrastructure, testing its air defenses and potentially prompting harder-line responses. Turkey and Pakistan have been explicitly warned by Houthis against any military involvement on Saudi Arabia's behalf.
sections.intelligence_notes: The identification of Nael Abu Obeid as a long-term hostage holder since 2014 provides actionable intelligence on Hamas's captivity network in Rafah's tunnel system. Muhammad Suleiman Bayouk's role in IED emplacement post-ceasefire indicates Hamas's continued asymmetric warfare preparation. The UAV over Urmia may signal Iranian air defense readiness or internal security operations. The Pentagon's admission of 'cascade of preventable failures' in the Minab school strike reveals U.S. targeting process vulnerabilities. The 203rd consecutive night of Iranian pro-regime rallies suggests domestic mobilization for potential conflict.
